page.overview:
Who is Nacelle Kayama?

Nacelle Kayama was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and also secretly a member of the Black Ajah., Nacelle Kayama}}

She was tall and slender and had blue eyes.

Romanda thinks that she is not particularly intelligent.

Nacelle has a One Power strength of , which is very weak for an Aes Sedai.
